purpose: Let Fold/Bloom surfaces remain alive without impersonating the human author.
definition: IDLE is autonomous projection/performance preview over current source evidence. It may move a view, follow a source clock and enact temporary demonstration gestures; it cannot create durable authored state.
laws: IDLE never mutates source bytes, source hash or AUDIO MAP evidence.
IDLE never persists generated BLOOM/FOLD/SPLIT/RETURN, PIN, PATH, cassette or composition state.
IDLE never emits an automatic gesture as an authored FIELD operation.
A loaded source may lend time/features while IDLE is active; source playback position may advance.
First direct human control exits IDLE and restores pre-idle authored state at the source's current address.
Audio autoplay remains browser/user-gesture bounded; silence does not disable the visual witness.
Synthetic demo material must be visibly identified as synthetic evidence.

bindings.live_09: Temporary RATCHET/release/branch performance over FIELD COURSE or loaded AUDIO MAP; state/deformation/ride/section arc restore on takeover.
bindings.listen_05: Changes aperture witness only at beat/phrase/section transitions; never scrubs, pins or edits source; restores prior aperture on takeover.
bindings.two_dial_0103: Temporary dial relations/composition gestures restore on takeover; local track may keep advancing as source clock.
bindings.glyph_atlas_01: Cycles focus among glyph cells; never changes authored path or message.
